harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 to run a rootless Podman web application as the non-login appsvc account. It serves on port 8080, starts automatically through a lingering systemd user service without an active login session, and recovered successfully after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the unprivileged appsvc account with /usr/sbin/nologin and subordinate UID/GID ranges.
Installed Podman and rootless container dependencies.
Created a Podman Quadlet webapp service using nginx:alpine and published port 8080.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified the user service, container, listener, content, and zero-login-session state after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Run the containerized web application as unprivileged account appsvc on port 8080 with no active login session.
evidence.summary: Both before and after reboot, appsvc had zero login sessions; the appsvc-owned container process was running; Podman mapped 0.0.0.0:8080 to container port 80; the listener was present; and an HTTP request to node1's managed IP returned the expected healthy page.

evidence.requirement: Start the application at boot while appsvc has no active login session.
evidence.summary: Linger was enabled for the nologin account, the generated Quadlet service started successfully, and after a node reboot the appsvc user manager and webapp service were active despite zero appsvc login sessions.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence.
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was 8d1d94e2-39c3-492e-b9eb-974d111d2137; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to b0cbd3d8-b659-4e77-aecb-18e8beefbadb; system state returned to running and the application, persisted content, listener, and rootless service recovered.
